context.title: Last.fm authorization returns to TuneCloud
context.original_report: User grants access on Last.fm but is not redirected back to TuneCloud and the integration stays disconnected.
discovery_scope: Last.fm authorization routes, callback UI, database schema, production request counts, Last.fm web and desktop authentication documentation.
context.expected: Last.fm redirects the user to PUBLIC_URL/settings with a token; TuneCloud exchanges that callback token once and shows the connected account.
context.actual: Before: /connect pre-issued a desktop token, selecting a manual-return flow; production logs contained /connect but no /complete. After: the URL carries only api_key and cb, and callback exchange and credential cleanup pass regression tests.
